dam_type: Composite Earthen Embankment with Central Masonry Spillway

source_b_technical_project_description.reference: Lower Bhavani Project Technical Description & Rehabilitation Engineering Literature

structural_components.material: Zoned Rolled Earthfill with Upstream Riprap and Downstream Rock Toe
structural_components.breachability_notes: Subject to progressive erosion or piping failure under extreme hydraulic stress. Selected candidate breachable component.

structural_components.material: Massive Rubble Masonry / Concrete Gravity Monolith
structural_components.breachability_notes: Massive concrete/masonry gravity section housing spillway and sluice monoliths; non-breachable under empirical earthen breach models.

structural_components.material: Gated Masonry Ogee Crest with 9 Radial Gates
structural_components.breachability_notes: Controlled hydraulic discharge structure with 9 radial gates (36 ft x 20 ft / 10.97 m x 6.10 m) on ogee crest.

structural_components.material: Zoned Rolled Earthfill with Main Canal Head Sluice
structural_components.breachability_notes: Contains the Lower Bhavani Main Canal headworks; alternative candidate embankment segment.

structural_components.material: Reinforced Concrete Conduit / Masonry Intake Tower
structural_components.breachability_notes: Controlled outlet conduit for downstream irrigation and power generation.

derived_approximations.derivation_formula: 8780.0 m (Technical Dam Length) - 464.0 m (Central Masonry Section) = 8316.0 m
derived_approximations.notes: Arithmetic subtraction only; not a surveyed or published individual component length.

selected_breachable_component.rationale: Represents the primary river valley embankment section directly impounding the deep reservoir pool adjacent to the central masonry section. Standard empirical embankment breach formulations (Froehlich, MacDonald, Von Thun) apply specifically to this earthfill component.
